set.body: Residual from UI-X1 close-out (2026-09-17): PairConstruction.withinDirected and withinUndirected (design/Paired.scala) still enumerate with their own loops and duplicate rule. X1's single pairing path holds for between-collection only. Fold within-collection pairing into the schedule (or a sibling schedule) so previews and resumable execution cover it, and extend PairConstructionLawSuite's independent oracle to the within relations.
set.title: Fold within-collection pairing into DirectedPairSchedule
